parameters.query:
SELECT 
    qf.*,
  to_char(qf.budget, 'FM999,999,990.00') AS budget_formatted,
    to_char(qf.budget_left, 'FM999,999,990.00') AS budget_left_formatted,
    to_char(qf.budget_left + qj."USD_allocated", 'FM999,999,990.00') AS total_budget_amount
FROM q_budget.q3_2026_final qf
JOIN q_budget.q3_2026_jbp qj
    ON qf."allocation_rule" = qj.allocation
    AND qf."allocation_keys" = qj."allocation#1"
    AND qf."type_of_income_expense" = qj.account
WHERE qj.sd = '{{ $('Jira Trigger').first().json.issue.key }}';

UPDATE q_budget.opercost_jbp AS fd
SET amount_in_usd = fd.total_amount * fx.fx_to_usd
FROM project_result.fx AS fx
WHERE fd.currency = fx.currency
  AND DATE_TRUNC('month', fd.end_date) = DATE_TRUNC('month', fx.reporting_month);
  
 update  q_budget.opercost_jbp 
 set amount_in_usd = round(amount_in_usd, 0)

UPDATE q_budget.budget_opercost bo
SET 
  budget_left = bo.amount_in_usd - agg.total_jbp_usd,
  budget_spent = agg.total_jbp_usd
FROM (
  SELECT 
    entity,
    beneficiary,
    start_date,
    end_date,
    SUM(amount_in_usd) AS total_jbp_usd
  FROM q_budget.opercost_jbp
  GROUP BY entity, beneficiary, start_date, end_date
) agg
WHERE TRIM(bo.entity) = TRIM(agg.entity)
  AND TRIM(bo.beneficiary) = TRIM(agg.beneficiary)
  AND agg.start_date = bo.start_date
  AND agg.end_date = bo.end_date;

SELECT 
  bo.*,
  TO_CHAR(bo.start_date, 'MM/DD/YYYY') AS bo_start_date_formatted,
  TO_CHAR(bo.end_date, 'MM/DD/YYYY') AS bo_end_date_formatted,
  TO_CHAR(bo.amount_in_usd, 'FM999,999,990.00') AS budget_formatted,
  TO_CHAR(bo.budget_left, 'FM999,999,990.00') AS budget_left_formatted,
  TO_CHAR(bjp.amount_in_usd + bo.budget_left, 'FM999,999,990.00') AS total_budget_amount
FROM 
  q_budget.budget_opercost bo
JOIN 
  q_budget.opercost_jbp bjp 
  ON TRIM(bo.entity) = TRIM(bjp.entity)
  AND TRIM(bo.beneficiary) = TRIM(bjp.beneficiary)
  AND bjp.start_date >= bo.start_date
  AND bjp.end_date <= bo.end_date
WHERE 
  bjp.sd = '{{ $('Jira Trigger').item.json.issue.key }}';

select * from q_budget.opercost_jbp oj 
where sd = '{{ $('Jira Trigger').item.json.issue.key }}';

DROP table if EXISTS q_budget.q3_2026_jbp_proc;

CREATE TABLE q_budget.q3_2026_jbp_proc AS
WITH SplitValues AS (
    SELECT
        sd,
        total_amount,
        account,
        allocation,
        TRIM(value) AS "allocation#1",
        "USD_allocated",
        start_date,
        end_date,
        currency,
        array_length(string_to_array("allocation#1", ','), 1) AS value_count
    FROM
        q_budget.q3_2026_jbp,
        unnest(string_to_array("allocation#1", ',')) AS value
)
SELECT
    sd,
    ROUND(total_amount / value_count, 2) AS total_amount,
    account,
    allocation,
    "allocation#1",
    ROUND("USD_allocated" / value_count, 2) AS "USD_allocated",
    start_date,
    end_date,
    currency
FROM
    SplitValues;

UPDATE q_budget.q3_2026_jbp jbp
SET "USD_allocated" = CASE
    WHEN jbp.currency = 'USD' THEN jbp.total_amount
    WHEN jbp.currency != 'USD'
         THEN jbp.total_amount * fx.fx_to_usd
    ELSE jbp."USD_allocated"
END
FROM project_result.fx fx
WHERE
    jbp.currency = fx.currency
    AND DATE_TRUNC('month', jbp.end_date) =
        DATE_TRUNC('month', fx.reporting_month);

----remove P charters  
UPDATE q_budget.q3_2026_jbp
SET "allocation#1" = REPLACE(REPLACE("allocation#1", CHR(13), ''), CHR(10), '');

-- First, update q1_jbp to ensure USD_allocated matches total_amount when currency is USD
UPDATE q_budget.q3_2026_jbp
SET "USD_allocated" = total_amount
WHERE currency = 'USD';

-- Update allocation to "Practice" for specific cases
UPDATE q_budget.q3_2026_jbp
SET allocation = 'Practice'
WHERE allocation IN ('Practice', 'Practice (Pool)', 'Pool', 'Acount');

TRUNCATE q_budget.q3_2026_jbp;

--- Inset into JBP Table  
INSERT INTO q_budget.q3_2026_jbp (
    sd,
    total_amount,
    account,
    allocation,
    "allocation#1",
    "USD_allocated",
    start_date,
    end_date,
    currency
)
SELECT
    sd,
    total_amount,
    account,
    allocation,
    "allocation#1",
    "USD_allocated",
    start_date,
    end_date,
    currency
FROM q_budget.q3_2026_jbp_proc;

UPDATE q_budget.q3_2026_final
SET 
    budget_spent = aggregated_jbp.total_allocated,
    budget_left = COALESCE(q_budget.q3_2026_final.budget,0) - aggregated_jbp.total_allocated
FROM (
    SELECT 
        jbp.account,
        jbp.allocation,
        jbp."allocation#1",
        SUM(
            CASE 
                WHEN jbp.currency = 'USD' 
                THEN jbp.total_amount 
                ELSE jbp."USD_allocated" 
            END
        ) AS total_allocated
    FROM q_budget.q3_2026_jbp AS jbp
    GROUP BY jbp.account, jbp.allocation, jbp."allocation#1"
) AS aggregated_jbp
WHERE 
    aggregated_jbp.account = q_budget.q3_2026_final.type_of_income_expense
    AND aggregated_jbp.allocation = q_budget.q3_2026_final.allocation_rule
    AND aggregated_jbp."allocation#1" = q_budget.q3_2026_final.allocation_keys;

INSERT INTO q_budget.q3_2026_final 
(type_of_income_expense, allocation_rule, allocation_keys, budget, budget_left, budget_spent)

SELECT 
    aggregated_jbp.account,
    aggregated_jbp.allocation,
    aggregated_jbp."allocation#1",
    0 AS budget,
    0 - COALESCE(aggregated_jbp.total_allocated,0) AS budget_left,
    COALESCE(aggregated_jbp.total_allocated,0) AS budget_spent

FROM (
    SELECT 
        jbp.account,
        jbp.allocation,
        jbp."allocation#1",
        SUM(
            CASE 
                WHEN jbp.currency = 'USD' 
                THEN jbp.total_amount 
                ELSE jbp."USD_allocated" 
            END
        ) AS total_allocated
    FROM q_budget.q3_2026_jbp AS jbp
    GROUP BY jbp.account, jbp.allocation, jbp."allocation#1"
) AS aggregated_jbp

WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 
    FROM q_budget.q3_2026_final f
    WHERE aggregated_jbp.account = f.type_of_income_expense 
      AND aggregated_jbp.allocation = f.allocation_rule 
      AND aggregated_jbp."allocation#1" = f.allocation_keys
);

INSERT INTO q_budget.q3_2026_jbp (
    account,
    allocation,
    "allocation#1",
    currency,
    end_date,
    sd,
    start_date,
    total_amount,
    "USD_allocated"
)
SELECT
    bp."Management account",
    bp."Allocation",

    COALESCE(
        NULLIF(bp."Allocation Employee", ''),
        NULLIF(bp."Allocation Entity", ''),
        NULLIF(bp."Allocation Project", ''),
        NULLIF(bp."Allocation Practice", ''),
        NULLIF(bp."Allocation Account", ''),
        NULLIF(bp."Allocation Presale", ''),
        'NA'
    ),

    bp."Currency",

    NULLIF(bp."End date of service", '')::date,
    bp."Issue Key",
    NULLIF(bp."Start date of service", '')::date,
    NULLIF(bp."Total amount", '')::numeric,
    0

FROM mrp.bill_payment bp
WHERE
    NULLIF(bp."Start date of service", '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(bp."End date of service", '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(bp."Start date of service", '')::date <= DATE '2026-09-30'
    AND NULLIF(bp."End date of service", '')::date >= DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND bp."Management account" <> 'Salaries expenses'
    AND bp."Opercost/overhead" = 'Overhead'
    AND bp."Allocation" <> 'Intercompany';

INSERT INTO q_budget.opercost_jbp (
    sd,
    entity,
    beneficiary,
    total_amount,
    amount_in_usd,
    start_date,
    end_date,
    currency
)
SELECT
    bp."Issue Key"                                              AS sd,
    bp."Allocation Entity"                                      AS entity,
    bp."Beneficiary"                                            AS beneficiary,
    NULLIF(bp."Total amount", '')::numeric                      AS total_amount,
    0                                                            AS amount_in_usd,
    NULLIF(bp."Start date of service", '')::date                AS start_date,
    NULLIF(bp."End date of service", '')::date                  AS end_date,
    bp."Currency"                                               AS currency

FROM mrp.bill_payment bp
WHERE
    NULLIF(bp."Start date of service", '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(bp."End date of service", '') IS NOT NULL
    AND bp."Management account" <> 'Salaries expenses'
    AND bp."Opercost/overhead" = 'Opercost'
    AND bp."Allocation" <> 'Intercompany';

INSERT INTO q_budget.q3_2026_jbp (
    account,
    allocation,
    "allocation#1",
    currency,
    end_date,
    sd,
    start_date,
    total_amount,
    "USD_allocated"
)
SELECT
    ap."Account"                                AS account,
    ap."Allocation"                             AS allocation,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(ap."Allocation#1", ''), 'NA') AS "allocation#1",
    ap."Currency"                               AS currency,
    ap."Fact of payment"::date                  AS end_date,
    'Autopayments'                              AS sd,
    ap."Fact of payment"::date                  AS start_date,
    ap."Amount"                                 AS total_amount,
    0                                           AS "USD_allocated"
FROM mrp.autopayments ap
WHERE
    ap."Fact of payment" >= DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND ap."Fact of payment" < DATE '2026-10-01'
    AND ap."Opercost/ Overhead" = 'Overhead';
